text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That run in the Milers Cup was the 
absolute best. It wasn't just god-tier, it 
was literal God. Helios God.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Mile GI Yasuda 
Kinen. My beloved crush Daiichi Ruby and 
Bamboo Memory will be there too. It's 
basically a festival!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mejiro Palmer was feeling down 
over her Tenno Sho (Spring) result... but 
God Helios praised her, saying her insane 
front-running breakaway was on a whole 
'nother level of cool.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When asked, "Did we really become 
besties?" she replied that they always 
were from the start, with a sun-like 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing God Helios fired up for the Yasuda 
Kinen, Mejiro Palmer makes a vow: 
"Whenever that light dims, I'll be the one 
to shine on you."
